Property awb0IsVi is a Boolean which represents whether item is variant item or not.
To show if the sub assembly is an end Item. If an assembly is an end item, then that assembly is not expandable in the structure.

awb0AssemblyIndicator is a string property. Assembly Indicator that represents a type of Part or Design. The valid values are 1. Configurable Assembly - Configurable Assembly can be associated with a Variability Scope. 2. Fixed Assembly - Assembly with a fixed set of Parts. Variant Condition cannot be authored on children of Fixed Assembly in a structure. 3. Component - Piece Part that can be assembled and used on a Product. Child Parts cannot be added under Component. Cannot be updated once Part is Released. 4. Generic Part - Generic Part cannot be assembled and used on a Product. It can be associated with a Variability Scope. Cannot be updated once Part is Released. Cannot be updated once the Part is linked with a Configurator Context. Child Parts cannot be added under Generic Part. The default value is Fixed Assembly.

Indicates if the line is quantity managed or not. It can have following values: 0 - Line is not quantity managed 1 - Line is quantity managed summarized line 2 - Line is quantity managed exploded line

awb0SkipAlignment is a Boolean. It specifies whether the target Part/Design occurrence is required respectively. False indicates that the target Part/Design occurrence is required. It cannot be changed once target occurrence is created and aligned. The default value is False.

awb0NeedMultipleAlignments is a Boolean. It indicates whether the part occurrence can be aligned with multiple design occurrences. False indicates that part occurrence can have only 1 aligned design occurrence. This property has to be set before performing the alignment. The default value is False.
This property describes the maturity of an Item Revision as it moves through its life cycle.
Property awb0ElementFilterState is a Runtime which represents elements discovery filter state.
This will return true if selected line holds PSOccurrence of type Secondary Component. This is non-modifiable property.
This will return true if selected line holds PSOccurrence of type Substitute component. This is non-modifiable property.
A functional or system level identifier that defines the purpose of an occurrence in a product (e.g. "front wheels").

An indicator of logical identity with a usage address which indicates unique use. For example, a usage address for "front wheels" may always have two expected positions (e.g. "left" and "right") for a specific configuration of the product. This property is typically used for CAD-BOM alignment purposes.
awb0NetVariability represent the net variability at each component in context of an assembly.
Show substitute component lines when set to True. Hide Substitute Component lines when set to false.

Represents the Primary BOMLines information on Substitute BOMLine.
awb0FinishIndicator is a string property. It Indicates if an item is a Less Finish item or Colored item. The valid values are Less Finish and Color.

Struct.name: ColumnConfigInput

StructElement.description:
The name of a client application, as represented by an instance of Fnd0Client in the Teamcenter database. This value must match the value of fnd0ClientName property.
For example: The client name for Active Workspace is "AWClient"
StructElement.name: clientName

StructElement.description:
Specifies the name of a hosting client application, as represented by an instance of Fnd0Client, in the Teamcenter databases. This value must match a value of the fnd0ClientName property.
For example: If client A is integrated with client B and the user can invoke client B commands from within client A, the input would specify client A as hosting client and client B as the client. If the caller wanted native commands for client A, client A would be specified as client and hosting client would be empty.
StructElement.name: hostingClientName

StructElement.description:
The operation that needs to be applied to finalize the columns to be returned back.
Supported values are:
"Intersection" - Gets the intersection of the columns for the types found in search results.
"Union" - Gets all the columns for the types found in search results.
"Configured" - Gets all the columns defined for requested scope irrespective of types in the search results . If it does not find any configuration at the specified scope it will search up in the order of scopes User, Role, Group and Site.
StructElement.name: operationType

Effectivity unit range, a valid range of unit numbers. Always specified in the context of the end Item to which the units apply. It can be a discrete, noncontinuous range.
Valid ranges are:
StartUnit
StartUnit - EndUnit
StartUnit - SO
StartUnit - UP
        Where, StartUnit < EndUnit.
StartUnit1 - EndUnit1, StartUnit2 - EndUnit2 (Ex. 10-12, 15-20)

All units are positive integers.

Valid ranges are:
StartDate - EndDate
StartDate - UP
StartDate - SO
        Where, StartDate < EndDate and EndDate != NULL.
StartDate1 - EndDate1, StartDate2 - EndDate2 (Ex. 01 January 2016 - 30 April 2016, 1 May 2016 - 30 July 2016)
        Where, StartDate2 > EndDate1

StructElement.description:
The map (string, string) of key and value pair. The valid keys that are returned by operation are objectUids, objectsToIndexSize, objectToIndexPageEndIndex, tcxmlFileTicket. The keys and corresponding values returned are based on the keys sent in the input ProcessOptions.

ProcessOption: objectsToIndexPageStartIndex, objectsToIndexPageSize
The query of the objects to index in the SOLR the response contains the object UIDs that need to be indexed. The following keys are returned “objectUids” with the comma separated list of the UIDs, objectsToIndexSize with the total number objects to index and objectToIndexPageEndIndex is the index of the last object UID returned.

ProcessOption: syncOperationType
The objects UIDs are returned in “objectUids” based on the syncOperationType value.
ProcessOption: export
For the export of the objects the tcxml file ticket will be returned with the key “tcxmlFileTicket” as the key.

ProcessOption: indexStatus
For the index status the response will have the string representation of the index status for each of the structure that is indexed. The key in the response will be the UIDs of the indexed product and value will be the status information.
StructElement.name: processResult

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation creates BOM windows (BOMWindow objects) from Active Workspace product contexts (Awb0ProductContextInfo objects). One BOM window will be created for each product context. The product of the Awb0ProductContextInfo will be set as the top line of the BOMWindow. With each BOMWindow there will be a corresponding list of BOMLine objects that identify any selections included in the product context information. The product context contains configuration data that will be set on the BOM Window when it is created. This information may include:

    • Revision rule
    • End item
    • Effective date
    • Effective unit
    • Saved Variant rule
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::ActiveWorkspaceBom::OccurrenceManagementCad::createBOMWindowsFromContexts
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
A map of input Awb0ProductContextInfo to BOMWindowAndSelections objects.

The following error originates from this operation:

    • 199002: A BOM Window could not be created from the product context. Please contact the system administrator to report this error.


Each selection corresponds to a user selected occurrence in the "Active Content Experience" (ACE) application in Active Workspace. This SOA operation performs the BOM expansions to return the list of the BOMLine objects of the selected occurrences. The BOM expansions will be limited only on the branches of the structure where the selected occurrences are and the expansions will only be up to the selected nodes.

OperationParameter.description: List of Awb0ProductContextInfo from which BOMWindow objects will be created.
OperationParameter.name: productContextInfos

OperationParameter.description: Flag that when true will cause the operation to process selections, returning the BOM lines of the selected occurrences.
OperationParameter.name: expandToSelection

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation creates BOM windows (BOMWindow objects) from Active Workspace saved bookmarks (Awb0SavedBookmark objects). A BOM window will be created for each product contained within each saved bookmark. With each BOMwindow there will be a corresponding list of BOMLline objects that identify any selections included in the saved bookmark. The product of the Awb0ProductContextInfo that is associated with each saved bookmark will be set as the top line of the BOMWindow. The product contexts also contain information that will be set on the BOM window when it is created. This information may include:

    • Revision rule
    • End item
    • Effective date
    • Effective unit
    • Saved Variant rule
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::ActiveWorkspaceBom::OccurrenceManagementCad::createBOMWindowsFromBookmarks
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
A map of input Awb0SavedBookmark objects to a list of BOMWindowAndSelections objects.

The following error originates from this operation:

    • 199001: A BOM Window could not be created from the saved bookmark. Please contact the system administrator to report this error.


Each selection corresponds to a user selected occurrence in the "Active Content Experience" (ACE) application in Active Workspace. This SOA operation performs the BOM expansions to return the list of the BOMLine objects of the selected occurrences. The BOM expansions will be limited only on the branches of the structure where the selected occurrences are and the expansions will only be up to the selected nodes.

OperationParameter.description: The Awb0SavedBookmark objects from which BOMWindow objects will be created.
OperationParameter.name: savedBookmarks

OperationParameter.description: Flag that when true will cause the operation to process selections, returning the BOM lines of the selected occurrences.
OperationParameter.name: expandToSelection

OperationTemplate.description: This operation creates Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances for the given products and configuration rules and/or updates existing Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances with the new list of variant rules. The state of the created/updated Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances is set to 'ReadyToIndex'; a scheduled process generates the index in the background.The product can be an ItemRevision or CollaborativeDesign(CD). The configuration rules comprise of a list of RevisionRule(s) with effectivity information and a list of saved SavedVariantRule(s) with their owning ItemRevision(s).
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::ActiveWorkspaceBom::BOMIndexManagement::createBOMIndexAdminData
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
A list of Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances that were created or updated and the ServiceData. Any failure is reported in the ServiceData as partial errors and mapped to the index of input list. The following partial errors may be returned:
    • 126207 - Owning ItemRevisions are not specified for the Saved Variant Rules. Please provide the ItemRevisions to which the Saved Variant Rules are associated.
    • 126208 - End Item not specified when specifying effective unit number.

OperationParameter.description: List of products with the rules to use to configure them
OperationParameter.name: productContexts

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation manages( generates, updates or deletes ) indices for the given product and configuration. Additionally this operation also generates a TCXML file which represents the configured product indices. The product and the configuration rules for which the indices are to be generated or deleted is specified through the input Awb0BOMIndexAdminData objects.
If the given product was already indexed for the given configuration rules, invoking this operation updates( deltas) for the the indices related to modified structures.
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::ActiveWorkspaceBom::BOMIndexManagement::processBomIndex
OperationTemplate.returnDescription: A ProcessBomIndexResponse structure which contains a list of ProcessBomIndexOutput for each of Awb0BOMIndexAdminData that was processed and the ServiceData. Any failure will be returned in the ServiceData as partial errors and mapped to the Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instance.

OperationParameter.description: The input which contains the processing options and the instances of Awb0BOMIndexAdminData whose state are either ReadyToIndex, IndexGenSuccess, IndexExportSuccess, SolrIndexGenSuccess and MarkedForDeletion.
OperationParameter.name: input

OperationTemplate.description:
Creates a new split Awb0Element object and calculates the occurrence effectivity of the new split Awb0Element and the source Awb0Element object. The effectivity is derived based on ChangeNoticeRevision effectivity and source Awb0Element effectivity objects.
For example, Awb0Element having occurrence effectivity of “01 Jan 2021 00:00” to “31 Dec 2022 00:00” and ChangeNoticeRevision (ECN) having ReleaseStatus effectivity “01 Jan 2022 00:00” to “UP”. The source Awb0Element occurrence effectivity is reduced (cut-back) to “01 Jan 2021 00:00” to “31 Dec 2021 23:59” and the new split Awb0Element will have occurrence effectivity “01 Jan 2022 00:00” to “UP” (Propagated from ECN). To perform split input parameters must satisfy below conditions:
•    The Awb0Element property specified in EffectivitySplitInput are from a PSOccurrence or Fnd0AbstractOccRevision property. For example: When an Awb0Element object has its property awb0Quantity represents the qty_value property of a PSOccurrence object then the awb0Quantity property name is valid for a split to be perform.
•    Source Awb0Element occurrence effectivity must overlap with a ChangeNoticeRevision effectivity. For example, if Source Awb0Element has effectivity “01 Jan 2021 00:00” to “31 Dec 2022 00:00” and ChangeNoticeRevision has effectivity “01 Jan 2022 00:00” to “UP”, then as ChangeNoticeRevision effectivity start date (01 Jan 2022 00:00) is before the end date (31 Dec 2022 00:00) of the source Awb0Element object, the dates clearly overlaps each other and valid for split operation.
•    The ItemRevision type for parent Awb0Element should have BO constant Cm0UsageEffectivityPropagationMode value is “Occurrence”.
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::ActiveWorkspaceBom::OccurrenceManagement::splitEffectivities
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
A list of EffectivitySplitOutput, for each input Awb0Element with the newly created Awb0Element. newSplitElement is set to NULL in case if split is not performed. It also contains a list of parent and children information. The input Awb0Element is added to the ServiceData updated list as its Effectivity is updated and newly created Awb0Element are added to the created list. The following partial errors may be returned:
•    126001 An internal error has occurred in the Occurrence Management module.
•    126002 No Adapter could be found to handle the request.

OperationParameter.description: A list of EffectivitySplitInput containing modified Awb0Element and property internal names along with InputContext and SortCriteria.
OperationParameter.name: effectivitySplitData

Operation.description: This operation creates Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances for the given products and configuration rules and/or updates existing Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances with the new list of variant rules. The state of the created/updated Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances is set to 'ReadyToIndex'; a scheduled process generates the index in the background.The product can be an ItemRevision or CollaborativeDesign(CD). The configuration rules comprise of a list of RevisionRule(s) with effectivity information and a list of saved SavedVariantRule(s) with their owning ItemRevision(s).
Operation.name: createBOMIndexAdminData
Operation.returnDescription:
A list of Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances that were created or updated and the ServiceData. Any failure is reported in the ServiceData as partial errors and mapped to the index of input list. The following partial errors may be returned:
    • 126207 - Owning ItemRevisions are not specified for the Saved Variant Rules. Please provide the ItemRevisions to which the Saved Variant Rules are associated.
    • 126208 - End Item not specified when specifying effective unit number.
Operation.useCase:
The system administrator sets up the runTcFTSIndexer(TeamcenterFTSIndexer) to run periodically.

A new product has to be indexed for a given configuration.
    • The client invokes createBOMIndexAdminData with the product and the configuration rules that need to applied during indexing. New Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instance gets created for the given product and configuration.
    • runTcFTSIndexer invokes processBOMIndex to generate BOM index. The input for the processBOMIndex is the Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances whose states are ReadyToIndex, IndexGenSuccess, IndexExportSuccess, and SolrIndexGenSuccess.


A existing product that has already been indexed have to re- indexed for modified configuration.

    • The client invokes createBOMIndexAdminData with the product and the configuration rules that need to applied during indexing. The existing Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instance gets updated for the given product and changed configuration.
    • runTcFTSIndexer invokes processBOMIndex to generate BOM index. The input for the processBOMIndex is the Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances whose states are ReadyToIndex, IndexGenSuccess, IndexExportSuccess, and SolrIndexGenSuccess.

ParameterInfo.description: List of products with the rules to use to configure them

Operation.description:
This operation manages( generates, updates or deletes ) indices for the given product and configuration. Additionally this operation also generates a TCXML file which represents the configured product indices. The product and the configuration rules for which the indices are to be generated or deleted is specified through the input Awb0BOMIndexAdminData objects.
If the given product was already indexed for the given configuration rules, invoking this operation updates( deltas) for the the indices related to modified structures.
Operation.name: processBomIndex
Operation.returnDescription: A ProcessBomIndexResponse structure which contains a list of ProcessBomIndexOutput for each of Awb0BOMIndexAdminData that was processed and the ServiceData. Any failure will be returned in the ServiceData as partial errors and mapped to the Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instance.
Operation.useCase:
The system administrator sets up the runTcFTSIndexer(TeamcenterFTSIndexer) to run periodically.

Generation and synchronization of Indices for a configured product

Having set up runTcFTSIndexer to run periodically, the system administrator performs the following sequence when a product has to be indexed for a given set of configuration rules and kept upto date with the changes to product structure:
    • Create a text file which contains the information about the product and RevisionRule and or SavedVariantRule that must be used for configuration .
    • Execute bomindex_admin utility using -function=create option and provide the text file that contains the product and the configuration rules.
    • Executing the bomindex_admin utility persists the product and the configuration rules on Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instance with a "ReadyToIndex" state.


The runTcFTSIndexer utility performs the following sequence to index a configured product:

    • Invokes processBomIndex by passing the processingOptions as updateTIEAMTables=true.
    • Finds all the Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances in the database using the findObjectsByClassAndAttributes operation from the Finder service.
    • Invokes processBomIndex with Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances whose states are ReadyToIndex, IndexGenSuccess, IndexExportSuccess, and SolrIndexGenSuccess.
    • runTcFTSIndexer utility downloads the TCXML file using the transient file tickets returned in the response of processBomIndex call. The TCXML file contains the representation of the configured product index that was generated.
    • runTcFTSIndexer uses the TCXML file to update the SOLR database which will be used during context search .
    • On successful update of SOLR database the runTcFTSIndexer utility sets the state as SolrIndexGenSuccess on the Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instance using the setProperties operation from the Core service.


Deletion of Indices for a configured product

The system administrator performs the following sequence when the indices of a configured product are to be deleted:
    • Create a text file which contains the information about the product, RevisionRule and or SavedVariantRule for which the indices were generated .
    • Execute bomindex_admin utility using -function=delete option and provide the text file that contains the product and the configuration rules.
    • Executing the bomindex_admin utility finds the Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instance corresponding to the product and the configuration rules specified in the input file and sets the status on it as MarkedForDeletion.


The runTcFTSIndexer utility performs the following sequence to delete the indices of a configured product:
    • Finds all the Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances in the database using the findObjectsByClassAndAttributes operation from the Finder service.
    • Invokes processBomIndex with Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances whose states are MarkedForDeletion.
    • runTcFTSIndexer utility checks the state of the Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances returned by the processBomIndex . For all those instances with state IndexDelSuccess the utility deletes the indices in SOLR.
    • runTcFTSIndexer now deletes the Awb0BOMIndexAdminData instances whose status is SolrIndexDelSuccess using deleteObjects operation from Core service.

ParameterInfo.description: The input which contains the processing options and the instances of Awb0BOMIndexAdminData whose state are either ReadyToIndex, IndexGenSuccess, IndexExportSuccess, SolrIndexGenSuccess and MarkedForDeletion.

Operation.description: The operation generates the index data for the structures that are marked for Smart Discovery Indexing using the utility “structure_discovery_index”. The data is exported to SOLR.
Operation.name: processSmartDiscoveryIndex
Operation.returnDescription:
The information related to each of the options provided in processOpitons.

The following partial errors will be returned:
•    126270: The key passed in the processOptions map is not supported.
•    126271: The value passed for the key in the processOptions map is not valid.
•    126272: The query to get the objects to index failed.
•    126273: The invalid object type provided for the export operation. Only supported type is PSOccurrence.
•    126274: The value passed for key “indexStatus” is not valid. The valid values are UID for “ItemRevision” object.
•    Any other error generated by the core infrastructure will be returned.
Operation.useCase:
The system administrator setups the TcFTSIndexer to run periodically to manage the Smart Discovery index. The TcFTSIndexer invokes the operation multiple times each sync cycle with various parameter to bring the index up to date. Following are the operations performed during the sync cycle:

Usecase 1:
Query objects to index : The operation queries for the instances of the PSOccurrence that need to be exported and indexed in SOLR. TcFTSIndexer indexer uses the operation to query for the objects that need to be indexed which are then processed in smaller batch sizes.

Usecase 2:
Export the objects: The operation exports data for the object UIDs passed as input and returns tcxml file ticket for the exported file.

Usecase 3:
Status of the indexes : The operation provides the information about the structure index status. The structures that are marked for Smart Discovery Indexing can be in one of the following states:
•    Index Available
•    Ready to Index
•    Not Indexed

ParameterInfo.description:
A map (string, string) of key and value pair. The key provided is the operation and the value controls the operation behavior. The supported key values are:

•    “objectsToIndexPageStartIndex”: value the index from where to return object UIDs.

•    “objectsToIndexPageSize”: value the maximum number of object UIDs to return. If more than PageSize objects available, then subsequent call need to be made. The response will have objectsToIndexSize and objectToIndexPageEndIndex to determine if subsequent call is needed.

•    “syncOperationType”: value “added”, “modified” or “deleted”. For querying the delta objects to be synced.

•    “export”: value list of comma separated UIDs of type PSOccurrence that need to be exported.

•    “indexStatus”: value “all” or UID of type ItemRevision. To get the status of the structures marked for Smart Discovery Index.

This service is intended to be called from within the Active Content Experience (ACE) module of the Active Workspace Client (AW). The following is an example scenario on how this service could be used.
    • User selects one or more occurrences in the ACE module of AW.
    • User then clicks on an action command, such as the "Open in Solid Edge".
    • The Open in Solid Edge command will first invoke this saveSelection() operation to save the selected occurrences to Teamcenter.
    • The Open in Solid Edge command will then launch the Product Context object to the Solid Edge CAD integration.
    • The Solid Edge CAD integration would then call the createBOMWindowsFromProductContexts() SOA operation to create a BOM Window based on the Product Context object launched from AW.
    • The createBOMWindowsFromProductContexts() operation would return the BOM Window created for the Product Context object and the list of BOMLine objects corresponding to the occurrences selected in AW.

Operation.description:
Creates a new split Awb0Element object and calculates the occurrence effectivity of the new split Awb0Element and the source Awb0Element object. The effectivity is derived based on ChangeNoticeRevision effectivity and source Awb0Element effectivity objects.
For example, Awb0Element having occurrence effectivity of “01 Jan 2021 00:00” to “31 Dec 2022 00:00” and ChangeNoticeRevision (ECN) having ReleaseStatus effectivity “01 Jan 2022 00:00” to “UP”. The source Awb0Element occurrence effectivity is reduced (cut-back) to “01 Jan 2021 00:00” to “31 Dec 2021 23:59” and the new split Awb0Element will have occurrence effectivity “01 Jan 2022 00:00” to “UP” (Propagated from ECN). To perform split input parameters must satisfy below conditions:
•    The Awb0Element property specified in EffectivitySplitInput are from a PSOccurrence or Fnd0AbstractOccRevision property. For example: When an Awb0Element object has its property awb0Quantity represents the qty_value property of a PSOccurrence object then the awb0Quantity property name is valid for a split to be perform.
•    Source Awb0Element occurrence effectivity must overlap with a ChangeNoticeRevision effectivity. For example, if Source Awb0Element has effectivity “01 Jan 2021 00:00” to “31 Dec 2022 00:00” and ChangeNoticeRevision has effectivity “01 Jan 2022 00:00” to “UP”, then as ChangeNoticeRevision effectivity start date (01 Jan 2022 00:00) is before the end date (31 Dec 2022 00:00) of the source Awb0Element object, the dates clearly overlaps each other and valid for split operation.
•    The ItemRevision type for parent Awb0Element should have BO constant Cm0UsageEffectivityPropagationMode value is “Occurrence”.
Operation.name: splitEffectivities
Operation.returnDescription:
A list of EffectivitySplitOutput, for each input Awb0Element with the newly created Awb0Element. newSplitElement is set to NULL in case if split is not performed. It also contains a list of parent and children information. The input Awb0Element is added to the ServiceData updated list as its Effectivity is updated and newly created Awb0Element are added to the created list. The following partial errors may be returned:
•    126001 An internal error has occurred in the Occurrence Management module.
•    126002 No Adapter could be found to handle the request.
Operation.useCase:
1.    Open an assembly in Content viewer.
2.    Set the Active ECN with ReleaseStatus effectivity.
3.    Selects Awb0Element having occurrence effectivity and modifies the awb0Quantity property on Awb0Element.
4.    Client invokes splitEffectivities operation on the selected Awb0Element with input property name awb0Quantity.
5.    Client identifies split Awb0Element from splitEffectivities and invokes the saveViewModelEditAndSubmitWorkflow2 operation on the new split Awb0Element with the modified property value. If split is not performed, then property values are set on source Awb0Element.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of EffectivitySplitInput containing modified Awb0Element and property internal names along with InputContext and SortCriteria.

    • 126224 - The replacement operation has failed, possibly because the BOMView Revision object is not modifiable, or because the input line is either a substitute line or a root line.

ParameterInfo.description: The Awb0Element, WorkspaceObject and Awb0ProductContextInfo needed to reconfigure and update the content for impacted occurrences of the WorkspaceObject.

Operation.description: The operation creates and updates the configuration and recipe on a Fnd0StructureContextData object under the Fnd0AppSession of Fnd0TempAppSession working context.
Operation.name: updateWorkingContext
Operation.returnDescription:
ServiceData containing updated Fnd0AppSession objects.
The following partial errors may be returned in the ServiceData object.

126053    <objectString> was not saved because <objectType> is an invalid type.
126054    <objectString> was not saved because it is locked.
126055    <objectString> was not saved because <operation> is not a supported operation.
126056    Failed to update configuration and recipe of working context.
Operation.useCase:
Case 1: User creates Fnd0AppSession from configured BOM Structure
User configures structure by applying configuration and recipe. The configured structure is used to create new Working Context of type Fnd0AppSession. The operation createRelateAndSubmitObjects is called which creates Fnd0AppSession object. Upon successful creation of Fnd0AppSession Active Workspace creates and attaches Fnd0StructureContextData. The configuration and recipe of source structure is extracted from Awb0AutoBookmark and persisted on newly created Session.

Case 2: User performs SaveAs operation on Fnd0AppSession
User updated configuration and recipe of Fnd0AppSession. The changes are not automatically persisted to Fnd0AppSession but updated in Awb0AutoBookmark associated with Fnd0AppSession. Now user performs SaveAs operation on opened Fnd0AppSession.
saveAsObjectsAndRelate uses deep copy rules to create new copy of Fnd0AppSession. Once new copy of Fnd0AppSession is created we have to update configuration and recipe on new copy using unsaved changes to original Fnd0AppSession on which SaveAs action was performed.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of input data containing product configuration, container and flag to decide whether to persist search result in Fnd0AppSession.

Operation.description:
This operation creates BOM windows (BOMWindow objects) from Active Workspace saved bookmarks (Awb0SavedBookmark objects). A BOM window will be created for each product contained within each saved bookmark. With each BOMwindow there will be a corresponding list of BOMLline objects that identify any selections included in the saved bookmark. The product of the Awb0ProductContextInfo that is associated with each saved bookmark will be set as the top line of the BOMWindow. The product contexts also contain information that will be set on the BOM window when it is created. This information may include:

    • Revision rule
    • End item
    • Effective date
    • Effective unit
    • Saved Variant rule
Operation.name: createBOMWindowsFromBookmarks
Operation.returnDescription:
A map of input Awb0SavedBookmark objects to a list of BOMWindowAndSelections objects.

The following error originates from this operation:

    • 199001: A BOM Window could not be created from the saved bookmark. Please contact the system administrator to report this error.


Each selection corresponds to a user selected occurrence in the "Active Content Experience" (ACE) application in Active Workspace. This SOA operation performs the BOM expansions to return the list of the BOMLine objects of the selected occurrences. The BOM expansions will be limited only on the branches of the structure where the selected occurrences are and the expansions will only be up to the selected nodes.
Operation.useCase:
The user has found a saved bookmark in the Active Context Experience. The user wants to open the contents of the bookmark in the CAD application. The Active Workspace Client communicates saved bookmark details to the CAD application, which then uses it as an input to this operation to create BOM windows.

When BOMWindow objects are needed but only Awb0SavedBookmark objects are accessible, this operation will use the necessary information from the Awb0SavedBookmark objects to provide corresponding BOMWindow objects.

ParameterInfo.description: The Awb0SavedBookmark objects from which BOMWindow objects will be created.
Flag that when true will cause the operation to process selections, returning the BOM lines of the selected occurrences.

Operation.description:
This operation creates BOM windows (BOMWindow objects) from Active Workspace product contexts (Awb0ProductContextInfo objects). One BOM window will be created for each product context. The product of the Awb0ProductContextInfo will be set as the top line of the BOMWindow. With each BOMWindow there will be a corresponding list of BOMLine objects that identify any selections included in the product context information. The product context contains configuration data that will be set on the BOM Window when it is created. This information may include:

    • Revision rule
    • End item
    • Effective date
    • Effective unit
    • Saved Variant rule
Operation.name: createBOMWindowsFromContexts
Operation.returnDescription:
A map of input Awb0ProductContextInfo to BOMWindowAndSelections objects.

The following error originates from this operation:

    • 199002: A BOM Window could not be created from the product context. Please contact the system administrator to report this error.


Each selection corresponds to a user selected occurrence in the "Active Content Experience" (ACE) application in Active Workspace. This SOA operation performs the BOM expansions to return the list of the BOMLine objects of the selected occurrences. The BOM expansions will be limited only on the branches of the structure where the selected occurrences are and the expansions will only be up to the selected nodes.
Operation.useCase:
The user opens an Item-BVR assembly in the Active Content Experience and makes changes to the RevisionRule or other configuration parameters. Then, the user opens it in the CAD application. The Active Workspace client communicates the Awb0ProductContextInfo to the CAD application, which then uses it as an input to this operation to create the BOMWindow.

When BOMWindow objects are needed but only Awb0ProductContextInfo objects are accessible, this operation will use the necessary information from the Awb0ProductContextInfo objects to create corresponding BOMWindow objects.

ParameterInfo.description: List of Awb0ProductContextInfo from which BOMWindow objects will be created.
Flag that when true will cause the operation to process selections, returning the BOM lines of the selected occurrences.

StructElement.description:
A map (string, list of strings) containing an option for compare as key and list of its associated attributes as values. The following supported key/values are:

Key “FilteringRule” with following list of values.
    • AccountabilityAll - Includes all lines.
    • AccountabilityLeavesOnly - Includes only leaf nodes; excludes all hierarchy nodes.
    • AccountabilityLinkedAssmOrLeaves - Includes assigned assembly nodes but excludes their children. If an assembly is not assigned, includes its leaf nodes.
    • AccountabilityMOA - To compare source and destination BOMs, traversing or skipping occurrences in the source structure based on the occurrence type of the linked occurrences in the destination structure.
    • DesignToBomAll - To validate completeness between part BOM and CAD BOM.


Key “DisplayOptions” with following list of valid values.
    • PartialMatch – Compare specific set of properties for a match between source and target structure.
    • FullMatch – Compare for exact match between source and target structure.
StructElement.name: compareOptions

Level to which the source or target is to be expanded for compare.
Value greater than 0 means level to which the source or target is to be expanded.

Value -2 means it is expected to get saved results if exists any.

Struct.name: CompareOptionsResponse

StructElement.description:
A map (string, list of strings) containing an option for compare as key and list of its associated attributes as values. The following supported key/values are:

Key “FilteringRule” with following list of values.
    • AccountabilityAll - Includes all lines.
    • AccountabilityLeavesOnly - Includes only leaf nodes; excludes all hierarchy nodes.
    • AccountabilityLinkedAssmOrLeaves - Includes assigned assembly nodes but excludes their children. If an assembly is not assigned, includes its leaf nodes.
    • AccountabilityMOA - To compare source and destination BOMs, traversing or skipping occurrences in the source structure based on the occurrence type of the linked occurrences in the destination structure.
    • DesignToBomAll - To validate completeness between part BOM and CAD BOM.


Key “DisplayOptions” with following list of valid values.
    • PartialMatch – Compare specific set of properties for a match between source and target structure.
    • FullMatch – Compare for exact match between source and target structure.
StructElement.name: compareOptions

Struct.description: Structure to store response of content comparison.
Struct.name: CompareResp2

StructElement.description:
A map( string, int ) of unique identifer and status for source. The map comprises of unique identifier of Awb0Element and its integer status in the source structure as compared to the target structure.UID of Awb0Element is followed by list of unique identifiers (UID) of equivalent Awb0Elements if any. The Awb0Element object can have one or more equivalent objects identified using equivalence and partial match criteria.The equivalent objects’ unique identifiers are populated when diff has status 2.
Integer value indicates below:
2 (Modified) – The object represented by the unique identifier has one or more property value differences when compared to target.
3 (Missing from Target) - The object represented by the unique identifier is missing in target.
StructElement.name: sourceDifferences

StructElement.description:
A map( string, int ) of unique identifer and status for target. The map comprises of unique identifier of Awb0Element and its integer status in the target structure as compared to the source structure.UID of Awb0Element is followed by list of unique identifiers (UID) of equivalent Awb0Elements if any. The Awb0Element object can have one or more equivalent objects identified using equivalence and partial match criteria.The equivalent objects’ unique identifiers are populated when diff has status 2.
Integer value indicates below:
1 (Missing from Source) – The object represented by the unique identifier is missing from source.
2 (Modified) – The object represented by the unique identifier has one or more property value differences when compared to source.
StructElement.name: targetDifferences

TcRuntimeType.description: Markup For Level Provider is a runtime data provider class to retrieve markup changes for given Awb0Element. Markup For Level Provider allows callers to use existing Finder::performSearch SOA operation to retrieve level markup changes for given Awb0Element via specific implementation at fnd0performSearch operation. The fnd0performSearch implementation will retrieve all markup changes based on the level.

Markup Provider is a runtime data provider class to retrieve markup changes for given Awb0Element. Markup Provider allows callers to use exiting Finder::performSearch SOA operation to retrieve markup changes for given Awb0Element via specific implementation at fnd0performSearch operation. The fnd0performSearch implementation will retrieve all markup changes based on input category. Possible values for category are "level" and "element".

OperationTemplate.description: This operation applies proposed changes that were stored in the active markup for the specified Awb0Element object, if the evaluate flag is false. If the evaluate flag is true, the write access to perform the save is checked and no modification is actually attempted. If the recursive flag is set, then all active Markups in the elements under the specified element are evaluated and/or saved.
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::ActiveWorkspaceBom::Markup::applyMarkup
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
Partial errors during applying markup changes.

The following partial errors may be returned:
    • 126248 Markups for “Object Name” were not applied.

Struct.description: <font face="courier" height="10">AlignedOccurrenceResp</font> structure represents output response for <font face="courier" height="10">findAlignedOccurrences</font> operation. For each input occurrence there will one or multiple aligned occurrences in the response.
Struct.name: AlignedOccurrenceResp

StructElement.description: A list of <font face="courier" height="10">InputOccToAlignedOccData</font>. Each <font face="courier" height="10">InputOccToAlignedOccData</font> represents relation between input occurrence and its aligned output occurrences.
StructElement.name: output

StructElement.description: Standard <font face="courier" height="10">ServiceData</font> object to hold the partial errors during <font face="courier" height="10">findAlignedOccurrences</font> operation.
StructElement.name: serviceData

Struct.description: <font face="courier" height="10">InputOccToAlignedOccData</font> structure represents the output parameter for <font face="courier" height="10">findAlignedOccurrences</font>. It holds the relation between input occurrence and its aligned output occurrences. For each input occurrences there will be one or multiple output occurrences.
Struct.name: InputOccToAlignedOccData

StructElement.description: An Awb0Element for which aligned occurrences are calculated. It is the same Awb0Element from the input of findAlignedOccurrences. The input for findAlignedOccurrences is the list of Awb0Element for which aligned occurrences are calculated. For each Awb0Element there will be one or more aligned occurrences so to create the relation between input occurrence and output aligned occurrence this Awb0Element is added as a part of InputOccToAlignedOccData.
StructElement.name: occurrence

StructElement.description: A list of Awb0Element to hold the output aligned occurrences for the input occurrence. When the input for findAlignedOccurrences is part occurrence then list of aligned occurrences will have design occurrence and when the input is design occurrence then list of aligned occurrences will have part occurrence.
StructElement.name: alignedOccurrences

OperationTemplate.description: This operation finds the aligned occurrences for input Awb0Element in given targetContext. For input part occurrence targetContext will be the top line of design structure and in case of design occurrence as input targetContext will be the top line of part structure. This operation returns design occurrence(s) or part occurrence for the input part or design occurrence. In case of summarized part occurrence all aligned design occurrences are returned.
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::EntCba::Alignments::findAlignedOccurrences
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The relation between input occurrence and its aligned output occurrences. For each input occurrence there will one or multiple aligned occurrences in the response.

The following partial errors may be returned:

416003    The find align occurrences operation failed due to incorrect input occurrence or targetContext.

OperationParameter.description: Awb0Element against which alignment needs to be calculated for the input occurrences. When occurrences are of the part type then targetContext must be the top line of design structure and when input occurrences are design type then targetContext must be the top line of part structure.
OperationParameter.name: targetContext

OperationParameter.description: A list of Awb0Elements for which aligned occurrences need to be calculated in the given targetContext. This can be a design occurrence or part occurrence. When part occurrence is the input then aligned design occurrence will be calculated and when design occurrences is the input then aligned part occurrences will be calculated in given targetContext.
OperationParameter.name: occurrences

OperationTemplate.description: This operation aligns the Part and the Design occurrences. If the Part or the Design context is given, the alignment is performed using the provided context. If no context is provided either for the Part occurrence or the Design occurrence, alignment is performed with the immediate parent occurrence as the context.
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::EntCba::Alignments::alignOccurrences
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
Partial errors during aligning Part and Desgin occurrences.

The following partial errors may be returned:
416003 Alignment was unsuccessful for the Part and Design Occurrence.
416005 Alignment failed due to invalid input.

OperationTemplate.description:
Description:
Imports an Excel file into Teamcenter and creates the product structure and sets the properties on objects based on the values given in Excel file. The input Excel file contains a level column to indicate the level of the object in the structure. ”Level” and “Object Type” columns are mandatory in the input Excel sheet. The input Excel file is parsed to import the data to create product structure in Teamcenter. This operation supports the creation of new objects and update of the existing objects. The column headers in excel are mapped to their respective properties which are saved as a mapping group on “import”. This operation support create and update of mapping groups.

Parameters:
importExcelData2     A list of type and property related data and the file ticket of the Excel file to imported.
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::XlsBom::Import::importExcelAndUpdateMappingGrp
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The column headers and property information after parsing the input file and a ServiceData element.

The following partial errors may be returned:
223509    The selected input file does not have mandatory columns “Tc_Level” and “Tc_ObjectType”.
223510    The header information in the selected input file does not match with the mapping input data.
223511    The input type provided contains required properties which are not supplied in the input Excel file.
223512    The input type provided contains MFK properties which are not supplied in the input Excel file.
223518    The creation or updation of mapping group failed.
141351    Invalid type for selectedObject passed in the input.

OperationParameter.description: The ImportExcelData structure contains all the data required to import a file to Teamcenter.
OperationParameter.name: importExcelData

OperationTemplate.description: This operation retrieves the page of structure information from the input Excel file. The output also contains a cursor that defines the place to start the next page location. The cursor must be passed back in to any subsequent call to get the next page of nodes.
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::XlsBom::Import::getStructureInfoFromExcel
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The structure information for given input Excel. The structure information is returned as a list of parent and its children information. It also contains column information and cursor to be sent back to the subsequent calls.

The following partial errors may be returned:
452001 The file could not be imported because the file path is invalid.
452002 The file could not be imported because no column headers are present for import.
452003 The file could not be imported because column "A" data does not end with "<endtag>"
452004 The file could not be imported because the top line (Tc_Level 0) is not specified.
452005 The filel could not be imported because column "B" header is not "Tc_ObjectType".
4520012 The file could not be imported because it is invalid file type.

OperationParameter.description: ExcelImportInput contains Excel file and mapped property info to retrieve the structure information. This data also contains cursor that represents point to which the results have to be fetched.
OperationParameter.name: inputData

OperationTemplate.description: This operation retrieves the page of structure information from the input Excel file. The output also contains a list of all sheet indices with their corresponding top line object names and a cursor that defines the place to start the next page location. The cursor must be passed back in to any subsequent call to get the next page of nodes.
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::XlsBom::Import::getSheetStructureInfoFromExcel
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The sheet details for the given input excel returned as a list of parent and its children structure information and all the sheet indices with their corresponding top line object names. It also contains column information, cursor to be sent back to the subsequent calls.
The following partial errors may be returned:

452001    The file could not be imported because the file path is invalid.
452002    The file could not be imported because no column headers are present for import.
452003    The file could not be imported because column "A" data does not end with "<endtag>"
452004    The file could not be imported because the top line (Tc_Level 0) is not specified.
452005    The file could not be imported because column "B" header is not "Tc_ObjectType".
452022    The file could not be imported because column "A" data does not end with "<endtag>" in “Sheet1”. The information is in the error message.
452023    The file could not be imported because no column headers are present in “Sheet1”. The information is in the error message.
452024    The file could not be imported because column "B" header is not "Tc_ObjectType" in “Sheet2”. The information is in the error message.
452027    The file could not be imported because the Tc_Level is not specified at row “2” in “Sheet2”. The information is in the error message.

Use Case:
1.    The user creates a new mapping group by mapping the property names with the column headers in the Excel sheet, giving a new group name and clicking on “Import” button.
2.    The user uses an existing mapping group by selecting a group name which populates the existing mappings and clicking on “Import” button.
3.    The user updates an existing mapping group by selecting a group name, changing some of the existing mappings and clicking on “Import” button.

OperationTemplate.description:
Unassign the membership of elements with their associated partition within the partition scheme.
If the user is in find unassigned Mode then additional added elements information will be returned.
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::ActiveWorkspaceBom::BOMPartitionManagement::unassignMembers2
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The unassigned Awb0Element objects in the Deleted list of ServiceData, the parent partition element Fgf0PartitionElement in the Updated list of ServiceData, and a list of newly added element information in the unassigned view.
The following partial errors may be returned:
•    126274: Invalid object to unassign because parent is not Partition.
•    280009: The current user does not have the required access privilege on the object to be able to delete the partition membership.
•    126001: An internal error has occurred in the Occurrence Management module.
•    126002: No Adapter could be found to handle the request. The system has not been adequately enhanced or customized to deal with the data given to it as input.

OperationParameter.description: A list of Awb0element and Awb0ProductContextInfo objects to be unassigned. Additionally, while using AW, if the user is in the specialized split view called “Find Unassigned” then include the sorting criteria of unassigned view.
OperationParameter.name: input

OperationTemplate.description: Unassign the membership of elements with their associated partition within the partition scheme.
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::ActiveWorkspaceBom::BOMPartitionManagement::unassignMembers
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
ServiceData containing successfully unassigned Awb0Element objects in the Deleted list and the parent Partition element Fgf0PartitionElement in the Updated list .

The following partial errors may be returned:
•    126274: Invalid object to unassign because parent is not Partition.
•    280009: The current user does not have the requested access privilege on the object to be able to update the Partition.
•    126001 : An internal error has occurred in the Occurrence Management module.
•    126002 : No Adapter could be found to handle the request. The system has not been adequately enhanced or customized to deal with the data given to it as input.

OperationParameter.description: A list of Awb0Element and Awb0ProductContextInfo objects to be unassigned.
OperationParameter.name: input

Operation.description: Unassign the membership of elements with their associated partition within the partition scheme.
Operation.name: unassignMembers
Operation.returnDescription:
ServiceData containing successfully unassigned Awb0Element objects in the Deleted list and the parent Partition element Fgf0PartitionElement in the Updated list .

The following partial errors may be returned:
•    126274: Invalid object to unassign because parent is not Partition.
•    280009: The current user does not have the requested access privilege on the object to be able to update the Partition.
•    126001 : An internal error has occurred in the Occurrence Management module.
•    126002 : No Adapter could be found to handle the request. The system has not been adequately enhanced or customized to deal with the data given to it as input.
Operation.useCase:
1: Unassign member of partition

User can select an element and do Partition->Unassign Member. This will unassign the membership of the element from the parent partition.

Unassign member option will only be available for the elements directly under the partition elements.
Members of one scheme can be passed in as input.

DeprecationInfo.deprecatedDescription: unassignMembers2 will be used in place of unassignMembers.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of Awb0Element and Awb0ProductContextInfo objects to be unassigned.

Operation.description:
Unassign the membership of elements with their associated partition within the partition scheme.
If the user is in find unassigned Mode then additional added elements information will be returned.
Operation.name: unassignMembers2
Operation.returnDescription:
A structure containing successfully unassigned Awb0Element objects in the Deleted list of ServiceData, the parent partition element Fgf0PartitionElement in the Updated list of ServiceData, and a list of newly added element information in the unassigned view.
The following partial errors may be returned:
•    126274: Invalid object to unassign because parent is not Partition.
•    280009: The current user does not have the required access privilege on the object to be able to delete the partition membership.
•    126001: An internal error has occurred in the Occurrence Management module.
•    126002: No Adapter could be found to handle the request. The system has not been adequately enhanced or customized to deal with the data given to it as input.
Operation.useCase:
Unassign member of partition
Users can select an element and invoke Partition group command > Unassign.
This will unassign the membership of the element from the parent partition.
Unassign member option will only be available for the elements directly under the partition elements.

2: Unassign member of partition in Find Unassigned View
Users can select an element and invoke Partition group command > Unassign.
This will unassign the membership of the element from the parent partition.
Unassign member option will only be available for the elements directly under the partition elements. An unassigned member will get added in the unassigned view not only without refreshing the entire structure but also according to the input sort order.

ParameterInfo.description: A list of Awb0element and Awb0ProductContextInfo objects to be unassigned. Additionally, while using AW, if the user is in the specialized split view called “Find Unassigned” then include the sorting criteria of unassigned view.

ServiceInterface.description: Service for managing Effectivity in a Product.
ServiceInterface.name: EffectivityManagement

Struct.description: <font face="courier" height="10">Criteria</font> provides information about recipe to search occurrences in a product.
Struct.name: Criteria

StructElement.description:
The type of search criteria represented in this structure. The list of valid values are:
Attribute: Indicates a property based search term
BoxZone: Indicates a type of spatial search term
PlaneZone: Indicates a type of spatial search term
Proximity: Indicates a type spatial search term
ClosureRule: Indicates a closure rule search term
Group: Indicates a groups of multiple search terms
Partition: Indicates a partition based search term
StructElement.name: criteriaType

StructElement.description: A list of internal values used within this search term.
StructElement.name: criteriaValues

StructElement.description: A user-friendly string representation of this search term.
StructElement.name: criteriaDisplayValue

StructElement.description:
The search term operator indicating the logic for combining this search term. The list of valid values are:
Include (OR)
Filter (AND)
Exclude (NOT)
StructElement.name: criteriaOperatorType

StructElement.description: A list containing grouped search terms. This list is empty if the recipe does not contain any groups.
StructElement.name: subCriteria

MetaEnum.description:
EffectivityImpactType defines the simulated impact classification for a BOM occurrence or effectivity segment in the multi-split occurrence preview.

It is used to describe how a BOM line behaves over a given effectivity range and to drive visual cues and interaction behavior in Active Workspace. All values represent preview-only outcomes and do not imply persisted changes.
MetaEnum.name: EffectivityLineImpactType

Struct.description:
EffectivityPreviewCell represents a single sparse cell reference within an effectivity preview row in the multi-split occurrence preview.

A cell links a row to a specific effectivity column and optionally conveys the impact type to support UI rendering and visual emphasis. The cell itself does not contain effectivity, BOM line, or part semantics.
Struct.name: EffectivityPreviewCell

StructElement.description: Index of the referenced effectivity column within the Preview table.
StructElement.name: columnIndex

StructElement.description: Indicates the simulated impact associated with the referenced column and is used for visual cues such as highlighting or styling in the UI.
StructElement.name: lineImpactType

Struct.description:
EffectivityPreviewColumn represents a single effectivity segment within the multi-split occurrence preview and acts as the source of truth for all split, cutback, and auto-revise semantics.

Each column defines how a specific BOM line behaves over a given effectivity range for a particular end item. All business logic related to effectivity and part assignment is captured here and referenced by rows only for preview and user interaction.
Struct.name: EffectivityPreviewColumn

StructElement.description: Identifies the BOM line associated with this effectivity segment in the context of the end item.
StructElement.name: sourceBOMLineUID

StructElement.description: Specifies the effectivity range covered by this column.
StructElement.name: effectivity

StructElement.description: Indicates the simulated behavior for the effectivity range.
StructElement.name: lineImpactType

StructElement.description: Identifies the currently assigned part for the BOM line within the effectivity range, if applicable.
StructElement.name: existingPart

StructElement.description: Identifies the newly created or revised part associated with this effectivity range, if applicable.
StructElement.name: newPart

Struct.description:
EffectivityPreviewHeader represents the preview header for a single end item in the multi-split occurrence preview.

It groups the ordered set of effectivity columns associated with the end item and defines the column layout used by Active Workspace to render effectivity-based split and cutback behavior.
Struct.name: EffectivityPreviewHeader

StructElement.description: Identifies the end item to which the effectivity columns belong.
StructElement.name: endItem

StructElement.description: Ordered list of effectivity columns defining effectivity ranges, BOM line context, and split/cutback semantics for the end item.
StructElement.name: effectivityColumns

Struct.description:
EffectivityPreviewRow represents a logical row in the effectivity preview table returned by the multi-split occurrence preview operation.

Each row groups a sequence of preview cells that collectively represent part assignments across all effectivity ranges for a specific preview context, such as the current state or the simulated state.
Struct.name: EffectivityPreviewRow

StructElement.description: Existing part associated with the row. Populated only for EXISTING_PART rows.
StructElement.name: partLabel

StructElement.description: Sparse list of cells referencing effectivity columns by index.
StructElement.name: previewCells

StructElement.description: Indicates whether the row represents an existing part or a new part (EXISTING_PART, NEW_PART).
StructElement.name: rowType

StructElement.description: Indicates whether the row is editable. Set to true only for NEW_PART rows.
StructElement.name: isEditable

MetaEnum.description:
EffectivityPreviewRowType defines the classification of rows in the effectivity preview table returned by the multi-split occurrence preview operation.

It indicates whether a preview row represents an existing part already present in the BOM or a new part introduced as part of the preview simulation. This classification is used by Active Workspace to control rendering, editability, and user interaction behavior.
MetaEnum.name: EffectivityPreviewRowType

Struct.description:
EffectivityPreviewTable represents the effectivity preview table for a single impacted BOM occurrence returned by the multi-split occurrence preview operation.

It defines a column-centric preview structure where effectivity ranges and split/cutback semantics are grouped by end item, and rows reference only the affected columns for UI interaction.

All data in this structure is preview-only and does not result in any persisted BOM changes.
Struct.name: EffectivityPreviewTable

StructElement.description: Defines the preview columns, grouped by end item and effectivity ranges, and contains all effectivity and BOM-line semantics.
StructElement.name: headers

StructElement.description: Defines sparse preview rows that reference column indices to support part comparison and user interaction in the UI.
StructElement.name: rows

Struct.description: <font face="courier" height="10">EffectivityRange</font> represents a single validity range for a product configuration, defined by unit based and date based start and end boundaries.
Struct.name: EffectivityRange

StructElement.description: Unit at which this validity range starts. Valid value is non zero positive integer number.
StructElement.name: unitIn

StructElement.description: Unit at which this validity range ends. Valid value is non zero positive integer number. Maximum value can be 2147483646 ( SO ) or 2147483647 ( UP ).
StructElement.name: unitOut

StructElement.description: Date at which this validity range starts.
StructElement.name: dateIn

StructElement.description: Date at which this validity range ends. Maximum value can be 26th Dec 9999 00:00:00 ( SO ) or 30th Dec 9999 00:00:00 ( UP ) in UTC timezone.
StructElement.name: dateOut

Struct.description: <font face="courier" height="10">InputContext</font> specifies the input information to apply to the structure from which occurrences are to be retrieved. This includes configuration rules, the page size (i.e., number of occurrences to fetch), filtering and sorting criteria, and criteria to fetch attachments.
Struct.name: InputContext

StructElement.description: Number of occurrences to be fetched per call.
StructElement.name: pageSize

StructElement.description: Busines Object Awb0ProductContextInfo that contains the product as well as all the configuration information that was passed as input to the service.
StructElement.name: productContext

StructElement.description: A configuration criterion applied to the product structure prior to retrieving occurrences, containing Effectivity, VariantRule, and RevisionRule settings.
StructElement.name: configuration

StructElement.description: A recipe used to search and filter occurrences, and to sort the results.
StructElement.name: filterIn

StructElement.description: Occurrence scheme associated with product e.g. CollaborativeDesign.
StructElement.name: occurrenceScheme

StructElement.description: Used to provide the Runtime Business Object created by Server during <font face="courier" height="10">setChangeContext2</font> SOA operation. It contains the Change Context applied and the Change Configuration Mode.
StructElement.name: changeContext

StructElement.description:
A map (string, string) of preference names and corresponding values.

includeInterfaces = true/false
Specifies whether interface occurrences are included in the returned structure. When it is true, interface occurrences representing logical or functional connections between components are included. When it is false, only primary structure occurrences are returned.

includeUnconfigured = true/false
Specifies whether occurrences that do not satisfy the applied configuration criteria are included. When it is true, unconfigured occurrences are included; when it is false, only occurrences that match the configuration criteria are returned.
StructElement.name: requestPref

Typedef.description: A map (string, SplitEffectivityDetails) in which the key is a BOMLine identifier to be split, and the value is a SplitEffectivityDetails structure that specifies the cutback Effectivity objects, new Effectivity objects, target ItemRevision objects, and the autoRevise behavior for that BOMLine.
Typedef.name: LineToSplitEffectivityMap

Struct.description: This structure provides the effectivity scope and the set of BOM occurrences that are evaluated to preview how occurrences would be split into multiple effectivity ranges. The input is used exclusively for simulation purposes and does not result in any persisted changes.
Struct.name: MultiSplitOccurrencesPreviewInput

StructElement.description: A list of Effectivity business objects that define the scope for the multi-split preview calculation. The operation analyzes how BOM occurrences would be split across these effectivity ranges. This parameter is required.
StructElement.name: inputScopeEffectivities

StructElement.description: A list of Awb0Element business objects representing the BOM occurrences for which multi-split preview results are requested. The operation analyzes each Awb0Element to determine how it would be split across the provided effectivity ranges. This parameter is required.
StructElement.name: listOfAffectedElements

StructElement.description: A map (string/list of string) containing request preference names as keys and their corresponding values as string lists. Used to control operation behavior and level of detail. This parameter is optional; pass an empty map for default behavior.
StructElement.name: requestPreferences

StructElement.description: The Runtime Business Object created by Server during setChangeContext2 operation. This holds the Change Context applied and the Change Configuration Mode. This parameter is required when operating within a change context.
StructElement.name: changeContext

Struct.description:
MultiSplitOccurrencesPreviewResp is the root response returned by the getMultiSplitOccurrencesPreview operation.

It provides the preview-only data required by Active Workspace to display how BOM occurrences would be split based on the given effectivity scope. All results are simulated and no BOM changes are persisted.

Struct.description: OccurrenceCfgInfo specifies the complete set of configuration rules including RevisionRule, Effectivity (provides range support) and VariantRule that must be applied to the input product to configure it and retrieve the required occurrence data.

Struct.description: <font face="courier" height="10">OccurrenceFilterInput</font> specifies the information about recipe to search and filter the result.

Typedef.description:
PreviewTableMap represents the preview data produced by the multi-split occurrence preview operation.

It maps each impacted Awb0Element UID to an EffectivityPreviewTable that defines how effectivity segments, BOM line context, and split/cutback semantics should be rendered in Active Workspace.

Each visualization table:
•    Groups effectivity columns by end item
•    Defines all business semantics at the column level
•    Uses sparse rows that reference columns by index for UI interaction

This structure is preview-only and does not persist any changes to the BOM.
Typedef.name: PreviewTableMap

Typedef.description: A map (string/list of string) containing request preference names as keys and their corresponding values as string lists. Used to control operation behavior and level of detail. This parameter is optional; pass an empty map if no preferences are needed.
Typedef.name: RequestPreference

OperationTemplate.description:
getMultiSplitOccurrencesPreview performs a preview simulation of multi-split behavior for Bill Of Materials (BOM) occurrences based on the provided effectivity scope.

The getMultiSplitOccurrencesPreview operation evaluates how the specified occurrences would be split into multiple effectivity ranges, identifies whether existing parts can be reused or new parts would be required, and generates detailed simulation and preview data for review in Active Workspace.

This operation is read-only and does not create, modify, or persist any data.
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::ActiveWorkspaceBom::EffectivityManagement::getMultiSplitOccurrencesPreview
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The operation returns preview preview data structured as follows:
•    Column metadata defining effectivity ranges and BOM line context
•    Summary information for each impacted Awb0Element in JSON format
•    Detailed multi-split simulation results grouped by occurrence and BOM line
•    Effectivity visualization data for UI rendering
•    Standard service information in ServiceData

All returned data represents simulation results only and does not reflect persisted changes to the BOM.

OperationParameter.description: Contains the scope effectivities, the list of Awb0Element, and optional request preferences used to control the preview behavior. The operation uses input to simulate multi-split result without modifying any business objects. This parameter is required.
OperationParameter.name: input

OperationTemplate.description: Executes effectivity-based split operations on BOM occurrences based on the provided Effectivity ranges. Supports multiple split instructions in a single transaction while ensuring BOM integrity. This operation is invoked when a user needs to split based on one or more Effectivity ranges (from an active ECN or user input).
OperationTemplate.name: Awb0::Soa::ActiveWorkspaceBom::EffectivityManagement::updateEffectivitySplits
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The response structure SplitEffectivityResponse which includes details of the newly added elements and their parent associations.

Following partial errors will be thrown:
233092: Invalid BOM line in LineToSplitEffectivityMap.
233093: Invalid effectivity specified in newSplitEffectivities.
233094: Invalid effectivity specified in cutbackEffectivities.
233095: Invalid revision specified in targets.

OperationParameter.description: Input structure containing the line-to-split mapping, Effectivity scope, product context, sort criteria, and request preferences required to execute the split operation.
OperationParameter.name: splitEffectivityInfo

Operation.description:
getMultiSplitOccurrencesPreview performs a preview simulation of multi-split behavior for Bill Of Materials (BOM) occurrences based on the provided effectivity scope.

The getMultiSplitOccurrencesPreview operation evaluates how the specified occurrences would be split into multiple effectivity ranges, identifies whether existing parts can be reused or new parts would be required, and generates detailed simulation and preview data for review in Active Workspace.

This operation is read-only and does not create, modify, or persist any data.
Operation.name: getMultiSplitOccurrencesPreview
Operation.returnDescription:
The operation returns preview preview data structured as follows:
•    Column metadata defining effectivity ranges and BOM line context
•    Summary information for each impacted Awb0Element in JSON format
•    Detailed multi-split simulation results grouped by occurrence and BOM line
•    Effectivity visualization data for UI rendering
•    Standard service information in ServiceData

All returned data represents simulation results only and does not reflect persisted changes to the BOM.
Operation.useCase: A client application integrating with Active Workspace BOM management needs to preview the impact of multi-split operations before committing changes. For example, when a user modifies Effectivity ranges for critical components, the application calls getMultiSplitOccurrencesPreview to show which existing parts will be reused and which new parts would be required, allowing informed decision-making before executing actual split operations. The application calls getMultiSplitOccurrencesPreview with the target effectivity scope and selected Awb0Element objects to simulate how BOM occurrences would split. The returned Effectivity ranges data allows the application to display detailed preview results to users for review and approval before executing actual split operations.

ParameterInfo.description: Contains the scope effectivities, the list of Awb0Element, and optional request preferences used to control the preview behavior. The operation uses input to simulate multi-split result without modifying any business objects. This parameter is required.

Operation.description: Executes effectivity-based split operations on BOM occurrences based on the provided Effectivity ranges. Supports multiple split instructions in a single transaction while ensuring BOM integrity. This operation is invoked when a user needs to split based on one or more Effectivity ranges (from an active ECN or user input).
Operation.name: updateEffectivitySplits
Operation.returnDescription:
The response structure SplitEffectivityResponse which includes details of the newly added elements and their parent associations.

Following partial errors will be thrown:
233092: Invalid BOM line in LineToSplitEffectivityMap.
233093: Invalid effectivity specified in newSplitEffectivities.
233094: Invalid effectivity specified in cutbackEffectivities.
233095: Invalid revision specified in targets.
Operation.useCase:
This operation is invoked in the following use-cases:

Use Case 1:
• User initiates Effectivity-Based Split by selecting one or more occurrences and specifies the desired Effectivity ranges.
• System validates the ranges for gaps and overlaps, simulates the split, and displays proposed effectivity splits.
• User reviews the simulation results and commits changes via this operation.

ParameterInfo.description: Input structure containing the line-to-split mapping, Effectivity scope, product context, sort criteria, and request preferences required to execute the split operation.
